<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:IO-004:40602393181 -->
## Verified resolution — important tests reviewed, direct closure

The desktop saver root cause is repaired: filesystem same-file identity protects self/normalized/symlink/hard-link exports; sibling staging closes streams before atomic replacement; null content explicitly replaces/creates an empty target; copying after native selection uses interruptible NIO ownership, preserves existing content on failure/cancellation and never deletes an unowned source.

All **six original acceptance criteria** reviewed against **14/14 important real filesystem tests on each of Linux x64, macOS arm64 and Windows x64**:
- Self-copy and normalized-path aliases preserve the source.
- Hard-link alias executed on all three hosts; symlink alias executed on Linux/macOS (Windows's privileged symlink branch is explicitly not claimed).
- Null saves produce empty existing and absent targets.
- Read/write failures after a real chunk close both owned streams and preserve source/destination; staging, atomic-move and cleanup errors retain truthful failures.
- Large streamed copy passes; a genuinely blocked 4MiB-copy regression cancels without releasing the fixture gate, closes both streams, performs zero commits and removes owned staging only.
- Normal Unicode selected-path/file/bytes/null saves and null native selection pass through the actual shared production copy contract. The existing modal/JNI ownership itself is not claimed to be interruptible or UI-tested here.

The old cooperative-dispatch control fails the exact blocked-copy regression. No new self-suppression defect is claimed: that older behavior already passed.

**Immutable verification:** [`03f6f510`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/03f6f51068efec6bbd4d209b1844f8ef3de2dc5d), [CI run40602393181](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40602393181). All736 selected inputs verified byte-for-byte against the tested Git revision; before/after input maps, artifact digests, every XML hash, exact commands and runtimes reviewed. Tests ran fresh (not cached XML).

**Run scope is reported honestly:** 254 passing /255 executed cases in45 XML, plus3 explicit platform N/A. The complete workflow is **failed**, because Windows `NativeCacheIsolationTest.concurrentExtractionOnlyReturnsIdenticalCompleteBytes` exposed an independent cached-payload sharing violation. All important saver/share-policy cases above pass on Windows. That native-cache defect remains open for correction under IO-005; this closure does not waive it, BUILD-006 or release readiness. Linux/macOS jobs are successful and will not be rerun unnecessarily.

Original issue body/labels/history/attribution retained. No physical/minimum-platform, visible native save-dialog, provider IPC, sanitizer, API/ABI, dependency/legal/full-consumer or release certification; no packages/releases/deployments published. Persistent evidence/ledger follow this direct closure.
